company.name: Houm
company.shortDescription: Houm is an end-to-end solution that helps property owners to rent and sell their residential properties up to 10x faster.
company.description: Houm is reinventing the way of leasing and selling properties in Latam by leveraging technology, data, and design to transform a currently painful and bureaucratic process into a pleasant, quick, and simple experience, both for the owner and for the tenant/buyer.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for property owners to list residential properties for rent or sale and for users to search and transact these properties.
productsAndServices.name: Houm Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A service that manages rental properties on behalf of owners, including tenant selection, rent collection, and maintenance coordination.
productsAndServices.name: Property Management Service

productsAndServices.description: Insurance-like plans that guarantee rental income to property owners even if tenants delay or default on payments, with varying coverage durations and protections.
productsAndServices.name: Rental Guarantee Plans

productsAndServices.description: A service to publish property listings with professional photography and promote them across major real estate portals to reach potential renters or buyers.
productsAndServices.name: Online Property Listing and Promotion

productsAndServices.description: A fully digital process for signing rental or sale contracts and submitting required documentation online to streamline transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Contract Signing and Documentation

productsAndServices.description: An online tool that calculates mortgage financing options based on property value, down payment, term, and interest rates.
productsAndServices.name: Mortgage Credit Simulator

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $35,000,000, or 78.3% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,689,515 to $167,617,543, a 45.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
